# Hungry Eyes Jamaican Restaurant & Bar

> Family-run Jamaican restaurant and bar in Short Pump (Richmond, VA), also branded Yaad Vibes Bar & Grill. Logo tagline: "See Good Food and Eat - Since 2009." Known for oxtail with rice & peas, jerk chicken, curry goat, rasta pasta and whole snapper, plus self-serve karaoke and a live DJ on Friday nights.

## Contact and location
- Name: Hungry Eyes Jamaican Restaurant & Bar (Yaad Vibes Bar & Grill)
- Address: 201 Towne Center W Blvd, Suite 707, Richmond, VA 23233 (Short Pump, West Broad Village area)
- Phone: (804) 664-2283
- Website: https://hungryeyesrva.com/
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hungry+Eyes+Jamaican+Restaurant+%26+Bar+201+Towne+Center+W+Blvd+Suite+707+Richmond+VA+23233

## Hours (Eastern Time)
- Monday: 11:30 AM - 7 PM
- Tuesday - Thursday: 11 AM - 9 PM
- Friday - Saturday: 11 AM - 10 PM
- Sunday: 12 PM - 6 PM
- Holiday closures are posted on Instagram @hungryeyesrva.

## Cuisine
Jamaican, Caribbean. Restaurant and bar.

## Menu highlights (prices from the in-house menu board; subject to change)
- Entrees come with rice & peas or white rice and steamed vegetables.
- Oxtail (signature; call for price)
- Jerk chicken (call for price)
- Curry goat (call for price)
- Curry chicken: $16.00
- Brown stew chicken: $16.00
- Fried chicken: $17.00
- Rasta pasta (call for price)
- Snapper meal: whole 1-2 lb snapper, fried, steamed or brown stewed (call for price)
- Whiting fish, shrimp, shrimp & fish platter, whiting fish sandwich (call for price)
- Wings (BBQ, fried, jerk or hot): 8 pieces $12.95, 12 pieces $17.95
- Beef patty $3.50, chicken patty $3.50, coco bread $3.00
- Roti: curry chick pea & potato, curry chicken, curry goat
- Sides $7.00 each: mac n cheese, fried plantains, candied yams, steamed cabbage or green beans
- Kids meal: chicken fingers & fries, or mac n cheese with whiting fish or chicken
- Drinks: homemade sorrel, homemade lemonade, Jamaican D&G soda, Ting, Snapple, Perrier, bottled Coke; full bar

## Friday nights: Yaad Vibes Friday
- Self-serve karaoke from 6 PM
- Live DJ from 8 PM until close (reggae, dancehall, soca, afrobeats, plus R&B and hip hop)
- Friday specials: jerk wings, rasta pasta special, $5 drink specials

## Ordering
- Dine in or sit at the bar
- Pickup: call (804) 664-2283
- Delivery: available on DoorDash

## Reviews
- Google: 4.5 stars from 245 reviews. Recurring theme: big portions.

## FAQ
- Do I need a reservation? No booking system; just come in. Call ahead for large groups.
- Is there parking? Yes, in the shared shopping-center lots around Towne Center West Blvd (West Broad Village area).
- Is it open Mondays? Yes, 11:30 AM - 7 PM.
- Is it family-run? Yes.
